notes.title: Tape Recovery Simulator 96K DEMO release date announced
notes.notes:
[b]Tape Recovery Simulator 96K[/b] is getting a [b]brand new playable DEMO[/b] version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41529642/c606efd14b209286a5f3dcabaabbf48eef31a438.gif[/img]

The DEMO will be available on [b]20th of November 2023 @ 9PM CET[/b]

The DEMO version contains the absolutely mandatory tutorial, the 3rd Goatsketcher tape, windows 11 compatibility, and a lot of bugfixes and improvements.

Further information available below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1816370/Tape_Recovery_Simulator_96K/
